name: monolith-platform
description: Monolith Hub - Central Hub & App Launcher for Lifestyle, Work, and Gaming with SSO

scripts.predev: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.predev:hub: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.db:seed: npm run generate && node --env-file=.env --import tsx apps/hub/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.admin:create: npm run generate && node --env-file=.env --import tsx scripts/create-admin.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.cf:build:hub: npm run generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build:worker --workspace=@monolith/hub
